set.body: After dense and sparse migration, remove the private ScalaFIM NDArray implementation, redundant NeuroImage representation machinery, raw-offset traversal, duplicate geometry ownership, and kernels now owned by Ravel or image4s. Retain compatibility names only as zero-cost source-facing aliases or extensions with a stated deprecation horizon; do not retain wrapper chains. Run the canonical matched workload court, checksums, allocation receipts, I/O and serialization compatibility, major algorithm and workflow suites, JVM and Scala.js gates where applicable, and standalone downstream consumer probes. Report visible regressions. Acceptance: no parallel dense multidimensional-array hierarchy remains; public hot paths are allocation- and performance-accounted; the execution epic can close and hand evidence to canonical reframe4s gate bd-01KYNR86DV1M5CZFR0P3K7J4YN.
set.title: Remove ScalaFIM image-array duplication and prove downstream consumers
